posts.cooked:
Flip City!!

 

10 cards gone (all the cards!) and the deck shuffled all together.

 

Baron Blade is now at 40hp, and you guys need to chill, you are crushing the poor man.

 

Baron Blade stopped running.  He turned and faced them, a hideous smile plastered on his scarred face.

He pulled out a remote as heroes turned the corner.

He laughed.  "MUAHAHAHAHA!"

The heroes froze, then the Baron's face changed, the smile to a scowl as he mashed the buttons on his remote.  "NO!" he shouted at the remote as he threw it against the ground.

Jim walked cooly out from an alley into the main street.

"You didn't think we'd walk into a trap that obvious, did you?" he said as he threw a handful of detonators into the street.

"You won't defeat me, I'll kill you all! The madman screamed, his voice cracking as he pulled out a huge gun looking contraption and started swinging it around.

"KILL YOU ALL!!!"

 

The forgotten Environment turn:

In the shadows an unseen ally looked over the scene, she had no idea who these people were, but she knew one side was working with the Nazi's, and while she did not have any attachment to these Americans, she had strong feelings about Nazi's.
